How to Size & Wear

Frequently Asked Questions

Is EasyPotty™ the same as a diaper?

No. EasyPotty™ is potty-training underwear. It is designed to help contain small accidents while allowing toddlers to notice wetness. It should not be expected to absorb as much as a disposable diaper.

Will it stop every leak?

No training underwear can guarantee complete leak protection. EasyPotty™ provides more protection than ordinary underwear, but heavy accidents, an incorrect fit, or delayed changing may cause leaks.

How does it help with potty training?

The underwear-like design supports independence, while the wetness feedback helps toddlers begin recognizing when an accident has happened. Combined with consistent potty breaks and positive reinforcement, this can support the learning process.

Can my child pull it down independently?

The pull-up style is designed to make bathroom trips easier. A child’s ability to use it independently will depend on age, fit, and motor development.

Can it be used overnight?

EasyPotty™ is best positioned as daytime training underwear.

Is it machine washable?

Yes. Follow the garment’s care label to protect its fit and absorbency.
